atoms.exact_source_text: Any Citizen may equip any Tool class when the physical manifestation is credible for their body.
atoms.normalized_claim: Any Citizen may equip any Tool class if the physical manifestation is credible for their body.

atoms.exact_source_text: Home Role, species, and prior profession do not gate Tool use.
atoms.normalized_claim: Home Role, species, and prior profession do not gate Tool use.

atoms.exact_source_text: Several Citizens may carry the same Tool class.
atoms.normalized_claim: Several Citizens may carry the same Tool class.

atoms.exact_source_text: Duplicate classes provide redundancy and different remembered protagonists
atoms.normalized_claim: Duplicate Tool classes provide redundancy and different remembered protagonists.

atoms.exact_source_text: they never stack on one Turn.
atoms.normalized_claim: Duplicate Tool classes never stack on one Turn.

atoms.exact_source_text: A Tool normally remains equipped to its holder at Home
atoms.normalized_claim: A Tool normally remains equipped to its holder while at Home.

atoms.exact_source_text: appears in Citizen View even when unrelated to the Citizen's Home Role.
atoms.normalized_claim: A Tool appears in Citizen View even when unrelated to the Citizen's Home Role.

atoms.exact_source_text: The player may freely leave, clear, or reassign Tools through Citizen View while Home.
atoms.normalized_claim: The player may freely leave, clear, or reassign Tools through Citizen View while Home.

atoms.exact_source_text: Routine reassignment is equipment management, not history.
atoms.normalized_claim: Routine Tool reassignment is equipment management, not history.

atoms.exact_source_text: A Tool brought by an arrival from prior life becomes an ordinary Colony Tool.
atoms.normalized_claim: A Tool brought by an arrival from prior life becomes an ordinary Colony Tool.

atoms.exact_source_text: Provenance is preserved
atoms.normalized_claim: A Tool's provenance from prior life is preserved.

atoms.exact_source_text: ownership rules are not special.
atoms.normalized_claim: Ownership rules for a Tool brought from prior life are not special.

atoms.exact_source_text: Tool choice belongs first to the Citizen's assumed identity, not to a party-coverage puzzle.
atoms.normalized_claim: Tool choice belongs first to the Citizen's assumed identity, not to a party-coverage puzzle.

atoms.exact_source_text: A Tool appears as an option only after the player has chosen an Approach that it can credibly affect.
atoms.normalized_claim: A Tool appears as an option only after the player has chosen an Approach that it can credibly affect.

atoms.exact_source_text: Selecting the Tool provides one contextual Tool effect and places its holder in Focus for that Turn.
atoms.normalized_claim: Selecting the Tool provides one contextual Tool effect and places its holder in Focus for that Turn.

atoms.exact_source_text: A Tool cannot be selected merely to force Focus, Tale attribution, or a Keepsake rider.
atoms.normalized_claim: A Tool cannot be selected merely to force Focus, Tale attribution, or a Keepsake rider.

atoms.exact_source_text: Only one Tool-derived mechanical advantage may apply to a Turn.
atoms.normalized_claim: Only one Tool-derived mechanical advantage may apply to a Turn.

atoms.exact_source_text: When several Tools are credible, the interface presents them as alternative ways of expressing the chosen Approach.
atoms.normalized_claim: When several Tools are credible, the interface presents them as alternative ways of expressing the chosen Approach.

atoms.exact_source_text: The player may choose none or one.
atoms.normalized_claim: The player may choose none or one of the credible Tools.

atoms.exact_source_text: If the selected Tool holder also has an applicable Focus Keepsake, that Keepsake rider may apply because the same Citizen holds Focus.
atoms.normalized_claim: If the selected Tool holder also has an applicable Focus Keepsake, that Keepsake rider may apply because the same Citizen holds Focus.

atoms.exact_source_text: Tools made for ordinary work may offer slight, contextual defensive utility in Conflicted MEETs.
atoms.normalized_claim: Tools made for ordinary work may offer slight, contextual defensive utility in Conflicted MEETs.

atoms.exact_source_text: There is no Weapon class, combat loadout, attack statistic, or separate martial progression.
atoms.normalized_claim: There is no Weapon class, combat loadout, attack statistic, or separate martial progression.
